data.headline: Bathroom demolition, tiling and asbestos safety preparation
data.summary: They remove bathroom tiles, waterproofing and fixtures, prepare dust controls using asbestos surveys, and tile bathroom walls and floors. They hold an asbestos removal certificate and an occupational safety card.

signals.rendering: They strip out bathrooms in apartment blocks by breaking tiles, removing waterproofing and carrying out the debris.
They check asbestos surveys and install dust walls and a negative pressure machine before demolition work begins.
They set up a negative pressure machine as part of dust control before bathroom demolition.
They tile bathroom walls and floors.
They hold an asbestos removal certificate.
They hold an occupational safety card.
